name: auth-bootstrap
title_zh: 首次登录时替你叫人的浏览器身份引导员
tagline_zh: 换新机器、碰到 SSO/2FA/通行密钥的墙，它不硬闯，把持久化浏览器配置好，只在你点头时把登录交回你手上。
tagline_en: Fresh machine or SSO/2FA wall? It sets up the persistent profile, then hands login back to you—only when you're.
desc_en: Log the persistent browser profile in for the first time. Use when the persistent profile hits a login wall, after switching to a fresh machine, or when SSO, 2FA, or passkeys need a human.
why_zh: 别的自动化假装能过验证码，它承认自己过不了——把该你做的留给你，把该机器做的先做完，边界划得干净。
why_en: Unlike automations that fake their way past CAPTCHAs, it admits limits—preps what a machine can, hands you only the human step.
limit_zh: 只处理首次登录引导，不负责绕过任何验证；需要浏览器已装好且能开图形界面，纯命令行无头环境它直接退出。
limit_en: First-login setup only; never bypasses auth. Requires a GUI browser—headless-only environments will make it exit.
title_en: Browser login helper that calls a human once
